learning_objective: 🎯 Learn how to draw and measure the wonderful world of straight paths, meeting points, and sharp corners!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A line goes on forever in both directions, but if we chop a piece of it, we get a line segment with two endpoints. A ray is like a sunbeam; it starts at one point and shoots off forever!
When two lines or rays bump into each other at a single point, they form a corner called an angle. We can measure how wide or narrow this corner is, just like opening a door!

fun_activity.title: ✂️ The Scissor Angle Hunt
fun_activity.instructions: Take a pair of safety scissors and slowly open them. Watch how the angle between the blades gets bigger! Now walk around your house and find 3 things that make a sharp corner.

quick_recap: ⭐ A point is an exact location, and lines connect these points.
⭐ Angles are formed wherever two lines intersect or meet.
⭐ You can find angles everywhere, from the corners of your room to the hands of a clock!
